title: 第三千三百七十二章 殷洛璃的两面性第三千三百七十一章 以防万一
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
殷洛璃一落地就从秦天怀里挣了出来，动作干净利落，她走到溪边，找了块干净的石头坐下，脱了鞋袜，将一双雪白的赤足浸入溪水中，舒服得微微眯起了眼睛。
她难得露出这样放松的神态。
平日里那股生人勿近的冷意都淡了几分，阳光透过树叶洒在她侧脸上，将那本就无可挑剔的五官衬得愈发清冷出尘。
秦天在洞口布下几道禁制，确保外界探查不到洞内的气息后，才走到她身边。
他坐下之后做的第一件事，不是调息修炼，而是很自然地把胳膊搭在了殷洛璃肩上。
殷洛璃没睁眼，长长的睫毛在阳光下泛着淡淡的金色，语气清冷如常：“手。”
“嗯？”
“拿开。”
“不拿。”
殷洛璃沉默了一瞬，指尖凝出一道细小的剑气，精准地抵在秦天的手腕上，声音又冷了几分：“拿不拿？”
秦天感觉到手腕上那丝凉意，不但没松手，反而变本加厉地把人往怀里带了带。
他下巴搁在她头顶，闻着她发间淡淡的清香，声音里带着笑意：“你舍不得砍。”
剑气在他手腕上停了两息。
然后，散了。
殷洛璃别过脸去，耳根处有一抹极淡极淡的粉色，语气却依旧冷冷的：“无聊。”
但她没有推开他，甚至，她的身体几不可察地往他怀里靠了靠。
秦天嘴角的弧度越来越大。他比谁都清楚殷洛璃的性子。
高冷是真的高冷，不是装出来的。
在别人面前，她是一座神圣不可亵渎的冰山，谁敢多看她一眼，她能一剑把人劈了。
但在他面前，这座冰山总有裂缝。

那些裂缝很小，小到只有他能看见，比如她嘴上说无聊的时候，身体却会不自觉地靠近他。
比如她每次威胁要砍他的时候，剑气永远只停在皮肤上，并没有达到能破开他防御的地步。
这种“双标”，大概就是殷洛璃表达感情的方式。
秦天得寸进尺，偏头在她耳垂上轻轻咬了一下。
殷洛璃的身体明显颤了一下。
她反手一掌拍在秦天胸口，力道不大，但带着明显的恼意：“秦天！”
“我在呢。”秦天笑着应了一声，声音里半点悔改的意思都没有。
“你再动一下试试。”
“试试就试试。”
秦天说完，又在她脸颊上亲了一口。
嘴唇触到她微凉的肌肤，一股清冽的香气传来，他心中烈火在燃烧。
殷洛璃猛地站起来，溪水溅了一地。
她转过身，脸颊微红，一双清冷的眸子瞪着他，威胁道：“你是不是以为我真不砍你？”
秦天举起双手做投降状，脸上的笑容却一点收敛的意思都没有：“好好好，不动了，坐回来，溪水凉，别冻着。”
“我可是规则统御者九重的人，还能被溪水冻着？”殷洛璃冷声道
“以防万一。”秦天面不改色。
content_en:
As soon as Yin Luoli landed on the ground, she broke out of Qin Tian's arms with clean movements. She walked to the stream, found a clean stone and sat down, took off her shoes and socks, and dipped her white bare feet into the stream. She narrowed her eyes slightly in comfort.
It was rare for her to show such a relaxed look.
The usual coldness of keeping strangers away from her has faded a bit. The sunlight shines through the leaves on the side of her face, making her impeccable facial features even colder and colder.
Qin Tian placed several restrictions at the entrance of the cave to ensure that the outside world could not detect the breath inside the cave, and then walked to her side.
The first thing he did after sitting down was not to practice breath adjustment, but to naturally put his arm on Yin Luoli's shoulders.
Yin Luoli didn't open her eyes, her long eyelashes glowed with a faint golden color in the sunlight, and her tone was as cold as ever: "Hands."
"Huh?"
"Take it away."
"Don't take it."
Yin Luoli was silent for a moment, then formed a small sword energy from her fingertips and pressed it accurately against Qin Tian's wrist. Her voice became a little colder: "Do you want to take it or not?"
Qin Tian felt the coolness on his wrist. Not only did he not let go, but he even tightened his grip and took the person into his arms.
He rested his chin on top of her head, smelling the faint fragrance of her hair, and said with a smile in his voice, "You are reluctant to chop."
The sword energy paused on his wrist for two breaths.
Then, they dispersed.
Yin Luoli turned away, there was a very light pink color at the base of her ears, but her tone was still cold: "Boring."
But she didn't push him away. In fact, her body almost imperceptibly leaned into his arms.
The curvature of the corners of Qin Tian's mouth became wider and wider. He knows Yin Luoli's temperament better than anyone else.
Being aloof is really aloof, not just pretending.
In front of others, she is an iceberg that is sacred and cannot be desecrated. If anyone dares to look at her, she can chop them with a sword.
But in front of him, there are always cracks in this iceberg.
Those cracks were so small that only he could see them. For example, when she said she was bored, her body would move closer to him unconsciously.
For example, every time she threatened to chop him, the sword energy would always stay on his skin, never reaching the point where it could break through his defense.
This "double standard" is probably Yin Luoli's way of expressing her feelings.
Qin Tian pressed forward, tilting his head and biting her earlobe gently.
Yin Luoli's body visibly trembled.
She slapped Qin Tian's chest with her backhand, not with much force, but with obvious annoyance: "Qin Tian!"
"I'm here." Qin Tian responded with a smile, without any hint of repentance in his voice.
"Try moving again."
"Just try it."
After Qin Tian finished speaking, he kissed her on the cheek again.
When his lips touched her cool skin, a refreshing fragrance came, and a fire was burning in his heart.
Yin Luoli stood up suddenly, and the stream water splashed all over the ground.
She turned around, her cheeks were slightly red, and she stared at him with a pair of cold eyes, threatening: "Do you think I really won't chop you?"
Qin Tian raised his hands in a gesture of surrender, but the smile on his face showed no sign of shrinking: "Okay, okay, stop moving. Sit back, the stream is cold, don't freeze."
"I am a member of the ninth level of the Ruler of Rules. How can I still be frozen by the stream?" Yin Luoli said coldly.
"Just in case." Qin Tian's expression remained unchanged.
